description: Figure 3 presents a series of pie charts illustrating the distribution of problems based on their correctness under two settings: with knowledge (w/ knowledge) and without knowledge (w/o knowledge). The charts are divided into three categories based on the difficulty of the problems: easy, medium, and hard. Each category is further subdivided into three slices representing the proportion of problems that were answered correctly (N+), answered incorrectly (N-), and not answered (N=). The colors of the slices are not distinguishable in the provided image, but they are typically used to differentiate between the categories. The charts do not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific slices. The order of the slices is not specified in the description.
